gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 diagnoses an inverted unitary transformation and an incorrect choice of P in the block reduction. Gold I003 concerns the outer square root in the global definition of D, which changes square-root scaling to fourth-root scaling and invalidates gs-34. These are different formulas and failed operations; the prediction does not recognize the D-scaling defect.

ISSUE-004 identifies an incompatibility between real T-palindromic block forms and a complex diagonal-basis condition, including the resulting constraint on an entry b. Gold I004 instead concerns the cited theorem's sign scope: the formal problem is (star,1)-palindromic while the prose claims epsilon=-1 applicability, and thm-IEP only concludes Q-star=Q. The prediction does not diagnose the missing general-epsilon theorem statement or sign-aware residual.
